project_argument: PROJECT is an absolute path to the Lean project directory (contains lean-toolchain and lakefile.toml).
out_argument: OUT is a new absolute output directory; output files must not already exist.
prerequisites: Install exact leanprover/lean4:v4.36.0-rc2 and pinned lake-manifest dependencies.
Obtain the complete lean-exposition distribution matching the packet source hashes; retain its actual revision/package hash, since none was supplied.
Do not substitute a partial import shim or synthetic graph for the actual installed consumer.

frozen_target_steps.expect: Successful real build/extraction, or retain actual failure unchanged. Capture actual stdout/raw report through the installed API if additional raw retention is required; the CLI graph contains sanitized receipt hashes, not raw process diagnostics.
Current graph schema, references and evidence contract checks pass.
Selected-goal list changes; whole graph is preserved.
Actual declaration dependencies, source identities and assumption/boundary records.
Actual retained sources and receipts, with no synthetic statuses.

candidate_steps.operation: Copy overlay/lean children into a disposable copy of the frozen project. Do not silently overwrite unrelated work. Existing QuarticQuery and QuarticCorpus libraries already own the module namespaces; no lakefile patch is needed.

candidate_steps.expect: Named complete types and #print axioms output; no nonstandard axiom or sorryAx for proof-bearing declarations.

candidate_steps.expect_diagnostic: Challenge and solution theorem statement do not match: 'QuarticQuery.Independent.Eq19.checked_eq19'

source_binding: Use the existing repository/tools/build_corpus.py::source_hashes on the repository root immediately before and after each command; retain actual command/exit/stdout/stderr/source inventories and the exact declared target. Candidate addition changes the whole-source snapshot, so no old root receipt becomes current for the enlarged project.
schema_scope: Native extract and select already call validate_graph in the supplied CLI. validate provides an explicit recorded repeat. Do not call full bundle validation: this target is a graph, not an authored three-paper bundle.
